modules.title: Introduction to Passion, Death and Resurrection
modules.html:
The Last Supper, the trial and crucifixion of Jesus, and the resurrection appearances. This section covers introduction to passion, death and resurrection.

Key points

  • The Roman Governor who sentenced Jesus to death was _____. — Pontius Pilate.
  • The disciple who doubted the resurrection until he saw Jesus was _____. — Thomas.
  • The Roman Governor who reluctantly sentenced Jesus to death was _____. — Pontius Pilate.
  • The resurrection of Jesus took place on the _____ day. — third.
  • The disciple who doubted the resurrection until he saw Jesus' wounds was _____. — Thomas.

Worked examples

Q: The Roman Governor who sentenced Jesus to death was _____.
A: Pontius Pilate — Pilate found no guilt in Jesus but succumbed to the pressure of the crowd to have Him crucified.

Q: The disciple who doubted the resurrection until he saw Jesus was _____.
A: Thomas — Thomas is often called 'Doubting Thomas' because he demanded physical proof of Jesus' wounds.

examples.q: The Roman Governor who sentenced Jesus to death was _____.
The disciple who doubted the resurrection until he saw Jesus was _____.

quiz.q: The Roman Governor who sentenced Jesus to death was _____.
quiz.solution: Pilate found no guilt in Jesus but succumbed to the pressure of the crowd to have Him crucified.

quiz.q: The disciple who doubted the resurrection until he saw Jesus was _____.
quiz.solution: Thomas is often called 'Doubting Thomas' because he demanded physical proof of Jesus' wounds.

quiz.q: The Roman Governor who reluctantly sentenced Jesus to death was _____.
quiz.solution: Pilate found no guilt in Jesus but gave in to the pressure of the crowd to avoid a riot.

quiz.q: The resurrection of Jesus took place on the _____ day.
quiz.solution: Biblical accounts and creeds affirm that Jesus rose from the dead on the third day (Friday to Sunday morning).

quiz.q: The disciple who doubted the resurrection until he saw Jesus' wounds was _____.
quiz.solution: Thomas, also called Didymus, said he would not believe unless he could touch the nail marks in Jesus' hands.

quiz.q: The gift of the Magi that symbolized Jesus’ future death and burial was _____.
quiz.solution: Myrrh was an expensive resin used for embalming bodies, prefiguring Christ's sacrifice.

quiz.q: Who doubted the resurrection of Jesus?
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2023). Correct answer: Thomas.

quiz.q: On the third day after his death, Jesus...
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2024). Correct answer: Rose from the dead.

quiz.q: "The wages of sin is death" is in?
quiz.solution: Past-question bank (legacy TXT). Correct answer: Romans.

quiz.q: Paul was a citizen of _____ by birth.
quiz.solution: Paul often used his Roman citizenship to appeal to higher courts and protect himself from arbitrary punishment.

quiz.q: The city of Jericho was captured by _____.
quiz.solution: Joshua led the Israelites in the miraculous conquest of Jericho where the walls fell down.

quiz.q: The gift of the Magi included gold, frankincense, and _____.
quiz.solution: Myrrh was an expensive ointment used for burial, symbolizing Jesus' future death.

quiz.q: The high priest who fell and died upon hearing that the Ark of God had been captured was _____.
quiz.solution: Eli died at age ninety-eight when he heard the news of the capture of the Ark and the death of his two sons.

quiz.q: The miracle of the feeding of the five thousand involved _____.
options: seven loaves and a few fish
quiz.solution: Matthew 14:17 specifies the boy's offering was five barley loaves and two fish.

quiz.q: Judas Iscariot betrayed Jesus with a _____.
quiz.solution: Judas used a kiss as the signal to the soldiers to identify which man was Jesus.

quiz.q: The first place where the disciples were called 'Christians' was _____.
quiz.solution: Acts 11:26 notes that it was in Antioch (Syria) that the name 'Christian' was first applied to believers.

quiz.q: Paul wrote the Letter to the Romans primarily to explain _____.
quiz.solution: Romans is Paul’s most systematic theological work, focusing on how humans are made right with God through faith in Christ.

quiz.q: Temptations occurred in:
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2021). Correct answer: Wilderness.

quiz.q: Saul converted at:
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2021). Correct answer: Damascus road.

quiz.q: Gideon defeated:
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2021). Correct answer: Midianites.

quiz.q: Naaman healed of:
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2021). Correct answer: Leprosy.

quiz.q: The parable of the Prodigal Son teaches about:
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2022). Correct answer: Repentance and Forgiveness.

quiz.q: The sons of Eli were:
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2022). Correct answer: Hophni and Phinehas.

quiz.q: Who built the first temple in Jerusalem?
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2022). Correct answer: Solomon.

quiz.q: God gave the Ten Commandments at:
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2023). Correct answer: Mt. Sinai/Horeb.

quiz.q: The raising of Lazarus showed Jesus as:
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2023). Correct answer: The Resurrection and Life.

quiz.q: Nehemiah was a:
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2023). Correct answer: Cupbearer.

quiz.q: The first four commandments of the Decalogue deal with man's relationship with...
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2024). Correct answer: God.

quiz.q: The Roman governor who sentenced Jesus to be crucified was...
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2024). Correct answer: Pontius Pilate.

quiz.q: According to Paul in 1 Corinthians 13, the greatest of these is...
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2024). Correct answer: Love (Charity).

quiz.q: Who interpreted Nebuchadnezzar's dream?
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2025). Correct answer: Daniel.

quiz.q: The division of the kingdom occurred under:
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2025). Correct answer: Rehoboam.

quiz.q: The Wheat and Tares parable represents:
quiz.solution: Past question (NECO 2025). Correct answer: Good and Evil people.

quiz.q: James was killed by:
quiz.solution: Past question (NECO 2025). Correct answer: Herod Agrippa I.

quiz.q: Shadrach, Meshach, Abednego refused to:
quiz.solution: Past question (NECO 2025). Correct answer: Worship the image.

quiz.q: Healed lame man:
quiz.solution: Past question (WAEC 2025). Correct answer: Peter.

quiz.q: Beatitudes:
quiz.solution: Past question (WAEC 2025). Correct answer: Matthew.

quiz.q: The woman was created from the man's?
quiz.solution: Past-question bank (legacy TXT). Correct answer: Rib.

quiz.q: God appeared to Moses in a burning bush at?
quiz.solution: Past-question bank (legacy TXT). Correct answer: Mount Horeb.

quiz.q: Rahab saved the spies in Jericho by?
quiz.solution: Past-question bank (legacy TXT). Correct answer: Hiding them on the roof.

quiz.q: Jonathan was the son of?
quiz.solution: Past-question bank (legacy TXT). Correct answer: Saul.

quiz.q: Shadrach, Meshach, and Abednego were thrown into a?
quiz.solution: Past-question bank (legacy TXT). Correct answer: Fiery furnace.

quiz.q: Belshazzar saw?
quiz.solution: Past-question bank (legacy TXT). Correct answer: Handwriting on the wall.

quiz.q: Which book discusses the building of the second temple?

quiz.q: Malachi means?
quiz.solution: Past-question bank (legacy TXT). Correct answer: My messenger.

quiz.q: The Transfiguration of Jesus took place on a?
quiz.solution: Past-question bank (legacy TXT). Correct answer: Mountain.

quiz.q: The criminal released instead of Jesus was?
quiz.solution: Past-question bank (legacy TXT). Correct answer: Barabbas.

quiz.q: The wine at the Last Supper represented Jesus'?
quiz.solution: Past-question bank (legacy TXT). Correct answer: Blood.

quiz.q: Saul's name was changed to?
quiz.solution: Past-question bank (legacy TXT). Correct answer: Paul.

quiz.q: The fruit of the Spirit is found in?
quiz.solution: Past-question bank (legacy TXT). Correct answer: Galatians.
